examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, okkācitavinītā parisā nopaṭipucchāvinītā? idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatāpaṭisaṃyuttā tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti.

38907.construction:
na + upa > nopa + lippa + ti
na + upalippati

examples.text: yathā'pi udake jātaṃ, puṇḍarīkaṃ pavaḍḍhati, nopalippati toyena, sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ.
tath'eva ca loke jāto, buddho loke viharati, nopalippati lokena, toyena padumaṃ yathā.
sabbattha munī anissito, na piyaṃ kubbati no'pi appiyaṃ, tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ, paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpati.
na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, sīlabbaten'āpi na suddhim'āha, adiṭṭhiyā assutiyā añāṇā, asīlatā abbatā no'pi tena, ete ca nissajja anuggahāya, santo anissāya bhavaṃ na jappe.

na + upa + e + ti

examples.text: ārogyaṃ samma'd'aññāya, āsavānaṃ parikkhayā, saṅkhāya sevī dhammaṭṭho, saṅkhyaṃ n'opeti vedagū'ti.
so vedanā pariññāya, diṭṭhe dhamme anāsavo, kāyassa bhedā dhammaṭṭho, saṅkhyaṃ n'opeti vedagū'ti.

38910.meaningLit: discourse on no diversity of sense experiences

38912.commentary: (MNa) nossū'ti taṃ bhūtaṃ khandhapañcakaṃ paccayasambhavaṃ nu kho, na nu kho'ti.

examples.text: tadāhārasambhavaṃ nossū'ti, bhikkhave, kaṅkhato uppajjati vicikicchā'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ, taṃ nirodhadhammaṃ nossū'ti, bhikkhave, kaṅkhato uppajjati vicikicchā'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
disvāna bhāradvājagottaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, kassa nv'ayaṃ bhoto bhāradvājassa agy'āgāre tiṇasanthārako paññatto, samaṇaseyy'ānurūpaṃ maññe'ti?

38915.commentary: (UDa) nhatvā ca pivitvā c'udatārī'ti gattānaṃ sītikaraṇavasena nhatvā ca pānīyaṃ pivitvā ca nadito uttari.

examples.text: nhatvā ca pivitvā c'udatāri satthā, purakkhato bhikkhugaṇassa majjhe, satthā pavattā bhagavā idha dhamme, upāgami ambavanaṃ mahesi, āmantayi cundakaṃ nāma bhikkhuṃ, catugguṇaṃ santhara me nipajjaṃ.
nhāt'āssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā
idh'ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsaṃ nhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pāturahosi sahass'āraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.

38917.meaning1: who is perfected; who is purified
38917.notes: (MW) m. one who has bathed or performed ablutions (i.e. a Brahman who, after performing the ceremonial lustrations required on his finishing his studentship as a brahma-cārin under a religious teacher, returns home and begins the second period of his life as a gṛha-stha

examples.text: usabhaṃ pavaraṃ vīraṃ, mah'esiṃ vijitāvinaṃ, anejaṃ nhātakaṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu samaṇo iti'pi brāhmaṇo iti'pi nhātako iti'pi vedagū iti'pi sottiyo iti'pi ariyo iti'pi arahaṃ iti'pi

38918.notes: (MW) snātaka m. one who has bathed or performed ablutions (i.e. a Brāhman who, after performing the ceremonial lustrations required on his finishing his studentship as a Brahma-cārin under a religious teacher, returns home and begins the second period of his life as a Gṛha-stha

examples.text: atha kho, bho, mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo satta ca rājāno khattiye muddh'āvasitte rajje anusāsi, satta ca brāhmaṇamahāsāle satta ca nhātakasatāni mante vācesi.

38922.meaning1: having taken a bath; having bathed; having washed

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito. so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nhātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā tatth'eva rukkhacchāyāya nisīdeyya vā nipajjeyya vā.
idha me, bho gotama, yaṃ divā pāpakammaṃ kataṃ hoti, taṃ sāyaṃ nhānena pavāhemi, yaṃ rattiṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ hoti taṃ pātaṃ nhānena pavāhemi.

38925.meaning2: bath-powder or anything useful for a bath

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpak'antevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya

examples.text: s'āyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi sneh'ānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca pagghariṇī
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpak'antevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya

tasmā hi ne namasseyya, sakkareyya ca paṇḍito, annena atha pānena, vatthena sayanena ca, ucchādanena nhāpanena, pādānaṃ dhovanena ca.
api ca kho mātugāmassa ucchādanaparimaddananhāpanasambāhanaṃ sādiyati.

yathā nu kho imāni, bhante, puthusipp'āyatanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsikaputtā āḷārikā kappakā nhāpikā sūdā mālākārā rajakā pesakārā

38932.commentary: (DNa) rosikaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesī'ti rosikā'ti evaṃ itthiliṅgavasena laddhanāmaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi.

examples.text: atha kho lohicco brāhmaṇo rosikaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, samma rosike, yena samaṇo gotamo ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ app'ābādhaṃ app'ātaṅkaṃ lah'uṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha
ime te, ambho purisa, cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā kālena kālaṃ vuṭṭhāpetabbā, kālena kālaṃ nhāpetabbā, kālena kālaṃ bhojetabbā, kālena kālaṃ saṃvesetabbā.
atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa dhātiyo upaṭṭhāpesi. aññā khīraṃ pāyenti, aññā nhāpenti, aññā dhārenti, aññā aṅkena pariharanti.

38935.meaning1: having caused to wash; having made bathe

examples.text: nhāpetvā anulimpitvā, veṭhetvā rājaveṭhanaṃ, chattena abhisiñcitvā, kāresuṃ puraṃ padakkhiṇaṃ.
sace vo, dhanena attho, khippaṃ maṃ bandhanā mocetvā sīsaṃ nhāpetvā ahatavatthāni acchādetvā gandhehi vilimpāpetvā pupphāni pilandhāpetvā ṭhapethā'ti.

38936.commentary: (DNa) nhāpesun'ti añño sarīraṃ ubbaṭṭesi, añño cuṇṇāni yojesi, añño tīre nahāyantassa udakaṃ āhari, añño vatthāni paṭiggahesi c'eva adāsi ca.

examples.text: aparam'pi divasaṃ nāgarājā saparivāro nhān'atthāya chaddantadahaṃ otari. atha dve taruṇanāgā soṇḍāhi usirakalāpe gahetvā kelāsakūṭaṃ majjantā viya nhāpesuṃ.

evam'āvuso'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, āvuso seyyasaka, yāva'd'atthaṃ bhuñja yāva'd'atthaṃ supa yāva'd'atthaṃ nhāya. yāva'd'atthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāva'd'atthaṃ supitvā yāva'd'atthaṃ nhāyitvā yadā te anabhirati uppajjati rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocehī'ti.
atthi keci buddhassa bhagavato uccārapassāvaṃ nhāyanti vilimpanti ucchādenti peḷāya paṭisāmenti karaṇḍāya nikkhipanti āpaṇe pasārenti, tena ca gandhena gandhakaraṇīyaṃ karontī'ti?
ekassa paccekabuddhassa jātassaraṃ oruyha nhāyantassa tīre ṭhapitesu kāsāvesu cīvaraṃ thenetvā tesaṃ hatthīnaṃ gaman'āgamanamagge sattiṃ gahetvā sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisīdati
asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi jantāghare nhāyitā… n'ābhijānāmi cuṇṇena nhāyitā

38941.meaning1: to bathe; to take a bath

examples.text: tam'enaṃ passeyya aparena samayena taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nhāyitvā ca pivitvā ca sabba-daratha-kilamatha-pariḷāhaṃ paṭippassambhetvā paccuttaritvā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā, ek'antasukhā vedanā vedayamānaṃ.
sattame divase pāto'va uṭṭhāya gandh'odakena nhāyitvā cattāri satasahassāni vissajjetvā mahādānaṃ datvā sabb'ālaṅ'kāravibhūsitā varabhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā
atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco, maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ, hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ

āraddhavīriyo viharati, kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ, na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

so tattha sīghena javena dhāvati. tassa sīghena javena dhāvato chavim'pi ḍayhati, cammam'pi ḍayhati, maṃsam'pi ḍayhati, nhārum'pi ḍayhati, aṭṭhīni'pi sampadhūpāyanti, ubbhataṃ tādisam'eva hoti. yato ca kho so, bhikkhave, bahusampatto hoti, atha taṃ dvāraṃ pidhīyati.

38946.meaning1: broken bits of tendon; tendon parings

examples.text: sā harit'antaṃ vā panth'antaṃ vā sel'antaṃ vā udak'antaṃ vā ramaṇīyaṃ vā bhūmibhāgaṃ āgamma anāhārā nibbāyati. hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ kukkuṭapattena'pi nhārudaddulena'pi aggiṃ gavesanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kukkuṭapattaṃ vā nhārudaddulaṃ vā aggimhi pakkhittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ
pāṇaṃ na haññe na c'adinnam'ādiye, musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā, abrahmacariyā virameyya methunā, rattiṃ na bhuñjeyya vikālabhojanaṃ.

pa, parā, ni, nī, u, du, saṃ, vi, ava, anu, pari, adhi, abhi, pati, su, ā, ati, api, apa, upa, pahāro, parābhavo, nihāro, nīhāro, uhāro, duhāro, saṃhāro, vihāro, avahāro, anuhāro, parihāro, adhihāro, abhihāro, patihāro, suhāro, āhāro, atihāro, apihāro, apahāro, upahāro, evaṃ vīsati upasaggehi ca.
so sato'va assasati, sato'va passasati. dīghaṃ vā assasanto dīghaṃ assasāmī'ti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto dīghaṃ passasāmī'ti pajānāti
bahum'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, na takkaro hoti naro pamatto, gopo'va gāvo gaṇayaṃ paresaṃ, na bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
yāva hi vanatho na chijjati, aṇumatto'pi narassa nārisu, paṭibaddhamano'va tāva so, vaccho khīrapako'va mātari.

38959.meaning1: annoying; irritating; troublesome; disturbing; (comm) greedy for taste
38959.notes: Also see MW prakṛṣ to distract, trouble, disturb.

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho udayo brāhmaṇo bhagavato pattaṃ odanena pūretvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, pakaṭṭhako'yaṃ samaṇo gotamo punappunaṃ āgacchatī'ti.
ken'āyaṃ pakato satto, kuvaṃ sattassa kārako, kuvaṃ satto samuppanno, kuvaṃ satto nirujjhatī'ti.
ahaṃ middhena pakato, vihārā upanikkhamiṃ, caṅkamaṃ abhiruhanto, tatth'eva papatiṃ chamā.
aho nūna bhagavā, aho nūna sugato, yo imesaṃ dhammānaṃ sukusalo'ti. bhagavā, bhante, kusalo, bhagavā pakataññū abhisaññānirodhassa. kathaṃ nu kho, bhante, abhisaññānirodho hotī'ti?

38964.meaning1: (vinaya) (of a monk) regular; who is not suspended

examples.text: yattakā bhikkhū tassa uposathakammassa pattayuttā anurūpā, sabb'antimena paricchedena cattāro bhikkhū pakatattā, saṅghena anukkhitā, te ca kho hatthapāsaṃ avijahitvā ekasīmayaṃ ṭhitā.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā saṅgh'uposath'ārahā cattāro vā tato vā atirekā pakatattā pārājikaṃ anāpannā saṅghena vā anukkhittā.

38965.meaning2: of good behaviour, of a sound taste

examples.text: cakkhussa rahonāma na sakkā hoti akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇīyamāne bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne sīsaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne passituṃ. sotassa rahonāma na sakkā hoti pakatikathā sotuṃ.

38967.meaning1: natural state; original form; normal condition

examples.text: varāha-eṇeyya-vigāḷha-sevite, pabbhārakuṭṭe pakat'eva sundare, nav'ambunā pāvusasitthakānane, tahiṃ guhāgehagato ramissasi.
saññasaññino vuccanti ye pakatisaññāya ṭhitā, na'pi so pakatisaññāya ṭhito. visaññasaññino vuccanti ummattakā ye ca khittacittā, na'pi so ummattako, no'pi khittacitto'ti.
pakati kho esā, kassapa, lokasmiṃ, dukkaraṃ sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ brahmaññan'ti.

38969.meaning1: (gram) uninflected form of a word; original form; natural state

examples.text: 318, 333. pakati c'assa sar'antassa.

38970.meaning1: primordial nature; source of the material world

examples.text: nirodhasuññāni vā tīṇi, nirodho ca sesattayasuñño. phalasuñño vā ettha hetu samudaye dukkhass'ābhāvato, magge ca nirodhassa, na phalena sagabbho pakativādīnaṃ pakati viya.

38971.meaning1: in character; in nature; naturally; normally
38971.meaning2: having the nature of, being by nature

examples.text: kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'ti ayakaṇṭake vā pakatikaṇṭake vā bhūmiyaṃ koṭṭetvā tattha cammaṃ attharitvā ṭhānacaṅkam'ādīni karoti.
cakkhussa rahonāma na sakkā hoti akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇīyamāne bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne sīsaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne passituṃ. sotassa rahonāma na sakkā hoti pakatikathā sotuṃ.

38975.meaning1: normal state of mind; usual state of consciousness
38975.commentary: (VISMa) pakaticittehī'ti pākatikehi kām'āvacaracittehi. (ADHa) pakaticitte'ti bhav'aṅgacitte. sabbe hi saññino sattā bhav'aṅgacitte ṭhatvā bhav'aṅgapariyosānena cuticittena kālaṃ karonti.

examples.text: sabbasattā hi pakaticittena bhav'aṅgacitten'eva kālaṃ karonti. ayaṃ pana avisodhetvā cittasantānaṃ kālaṃ karissatī'ti etam'atthaṃ sandhāya evaṃ vutto'ti veditabbo.

38976.meaning1: of sound mind; with a normal state of mind

examples.text: yadā ca pana pakaticitto ahosi paṭiladdhassati, tadā puna'd'eva pabbajitvā pañc'ābhiññāyo nibbattetvā brahmalok'ūpago ahosī'ti. sādhu, bhante nāgasena, evam'etaṃ tathā sampaṭicchāmī'ti.

38977.commentary: (VINa) pakatipaṭiyattan'ti pakatiyā tass'eva bhikkhuno atthāya paṭiyāditaṃ hoti, therassa dassāmā'ti.

examples.text: gihisamārambho nāma ñātakā vā honti pavāritā vā pakatipaṭiyattaṃ vā.

38979.meaning1: natural state; original condition; unaltered form
38979.commentary: (MNt) pakatibhāvan'ti sabhāvabhūtaṃ pakatiṃ, vado'ti-ādinā vā vuttaṃ pakatisaṅkhātaṃ sabhāvaṃ.

examples.text: avipariṇāmadhammo'ti attano pakatibhāvaṃ avijahanadhammo, kakaṇṭako viya nānappakārataṃ n'āpajjati.

38980.meaning1: (gram) natural state; original form; normal condition

examples.text: luttāsu vibhattīsu assa sar'antassa liṅgassa pakatirūpāni honti. cakkhusotaṃ, mukhanāsikaṃ, rājaputto, rājapuriso.
yo kho pana, bhante, brahmuno pakativaṇṇo anabhisambhavanīyo so devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ cakkhupathasmiṃ.

38986.notes: (Ñāṇadīpa) Cf. Cetanā Sutta of the Nidāna Saṃyutta (SN 12:38/ii,65): yañ'ca kho… ceteti yañca pakappeti yañ'ca anuseti, ārammanam etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.

examples.text: gedhaṃ brūmi mah'ogho'ti, ājavaṃ brūmi jappanaṃ, ārammaṇaṃ pakappanaṃ, kāmapaṅko duraccayo.

38988.commentary: (SNa) sallam'pi ce urasi pakappayeyyun'ti tikhiṇasattisallaṃ ce'pi urasmiṃ cāreyeyyuṃ.

examples.text: nabhaṃ phaleyya pathavī caleyya, sabbe'pi pāṇā uda santaseyyuṃ, sallam'pi ce urasi pakappayeyyuṃ, upadhīsu tāṇaṃ na karonti buddhā'ti.

38989.meaning1: having theorized; having designed; having devised; having contrived

examples.text: na h'eva saccāni bahūni nānā, aññatra saññāya niccāni loke, takkañ'ca diṭṭhīsu pakappayitvā, saccaṃ musā'ti dvayadhammam'āhu.

38990.meaning1: (of an idea or opinion) imagined; fabricated; fashioned; designed; devised; concocted

examples.text: tass'īdha diṭṭhe va sute mute vā, pakappitā n'atthi aṇū'pi saññā, taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ diṭṭhim'anādiyānaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmiṃ vikappayeyya.
nivissavādī na hi subbināyo, pakappitaṃ diṭṭhi purekkharāno, yaṃ nissito tattha subhaṃ vadāno, suddhiṃvado tattha tath'addasā so.
yañ'ca, bhikkhave, ceteti yañ'ca pakappeti yañ'ca anuseti, ārammaṇam'etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
ye bhoto rañño janapade ussahanti rājaporise, tesaṃ bhavaṃ rājā bhattavetanaṃ pakappetu. te ca manussā sakammapasutā rañño janapadaṃ na viheṭhessanti, mahā ca rañño rāsiko bhavissati.

38994.meaning1: having designed; having devised; having planned
38994.meaning2: having considered, having designed, having arranged, having thought over

38999.commentary: (THIa) taṇhāya sabbakilesehi ca ito c'ito ca kampitatāya calitatāya pakampito.

examples.text: sabbo ādīpito loko, sabbo loko padīpito, sabbo pajjalito loko, sabbo loko pakampito.
